authorizedRoute.routeType: public first-party Music Department email for music submissions or distribution concerns; separate published postal contact not treated as authorized music delivery
authorizedRoute.contactPublication: WXYC's official Contact page publishes md@wxyc.org in plaintext and explicitly directs music submissions or distribution concerns to it. The page also publishes a Music Department postal address, but does not explicitly authorize sending physical music media.
authorizedRoute.explicitPurpose: Music submissions and distribution concerns through the Music Department email.
authorizedRoute.permittedAutomatedScope: discovery, passive verification, enrichment, deduplication and queueing only
authorizedRoute.safeHumanAction: Confirm the current preferred digital delivery method and unresolved eligibility requirements, then send one individually selected MarcsMusic release through the Music Department email. Use the postal contact only after WXYC expressly confirms that physical music delivery is accepted.

businessContact.emailStatus: one usable public Music Department submission mailbox verified from the official Contact page
businessContact.verification: The official WXYC Contact page explicitly states that music submissions or distribution concerns should be emailed to md@wxyc.org. The address has valid syntax and matches the official wxyc.org domain. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probing was performed.

formBoundary.manualRecheckReason: The canonical route is a public email address rather than a submission form. A human must verify the live page and current delivery requirements and must stop if any linked workflow introduces authentication, CAPTCHA, consent, payment or other protected controls.
adjacentRoutesExcluded: PSA form available only by contacting the Communications Manager

activityVerification.evidence: WXYC's official Programming page states that the station broadcasts 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. The official site published a summer-DJ recruitment notice dated May 11, 2026, an artist interview dated June 7, 2026 and a festival review dated June 8, 2026. Its Archive page contains programming through the week of May 31, 2026.

genreFitEvidence: WXYC describes its regular schedule as a freeform mix of any and all types of twentieth- and twenty-first-century music.
The station says it tends to favor music that receives limited airplay elsewhere in the Triangle area.
New Science Experience explicitly includes house, techno, hip-hop, ambient and underground dance.
A selected MarcsMusic electronic, bass, reggae, world-fusion, ambient or experimental release has plausible fit, subject to human track selection and current submission requirements.
newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: WXYC explicitly authorizes music submissions by public Music Department email, but digital-delivery mechanics, international eligibility, accepted release types, formats, file limits, metadata, release timing, explicit-content rules and AI-origin policy remain unpublished. The separately published postal address is not treated as authorization to send physical music. Human review is required before one compliant email delivery.

deduplication.repositoryEvidence: Repository code search was performed for WXYC before creation and returned no existing music-submission-agent platform, seed or queue record. The public submission mailbox is stored once as the canonical route; the postal address is retained only as an unconfirmed contact boundary.
deduplication.consolidation: The Music Department email is the canonical opportunity. The published postal contact is not counted as a physical submission route without explicit confirmation. The outreach, general-information and PSA contacts, individual DJs, specialty programmes and social-media routes are excluded as duplicates or unauthorized substitutes.

notes: One new free-first WXYC opportunity was queued as needs_manual_review. The official Contact page explicitly authorizes md@wxyc.org for music submissions or distribution concerns. A separately published Music Department postal address was recorded as an unconfirmed contact point, not as authorization to send physical media. No submission was made.
